name: swooping-talons-level-two-mode-refuses-memory-only-item-destroys-low-reserve-item
notes: Swooping Talons (rj52215upu) with a level-2 champion: of Scepter of Lumina (memory 1, no reserve) and Forest Cake (reserve 2) only Forest Cake is selectable. Pre-fix both were offered.

rulesClauses: [Level 2+] Destroy target item with memory cost 0 or reserve cost 4 or less.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Swooping Talons' destroy mode (and Smashing Force's destroy step) build their target list in hand-written helpers (SwoopingTalonsMode2, SmashingForceBanish2 in Custom/CardDQHandlers.php) with the same filter as the generated code, "CardCost_memory($id) == 0 || CardCost_reserve($id) <= 4". The card data uses -1 for "no such cost", so every memory-only item (memory cost 1+, no reserve cost; e.g. Scepter of Lumina) satisfied "reserve <= 4" and was offered as a target. Both now use ItemLowCostMatches() (Custom/GameLogic.php), as do the generated closures (overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php).
